issues.description: Shebang is #!/bin/bash but code_style rule specifies #!/usr/bin/zsh for shell scripts.
issues.recommendation: Consider using #!/usr/bin/zsh per code style convention, though #!/bin/bash is functionally correct for this test script.

issues.description: url = "" is present without value. Code style rule flags url = "" # CI fills this as a template placeholder.
issues.recommendation: Per task instructions, url="" is expected (CI fills it). No action required for this audit.

issues.description: Hardcoded fallback path /data/service/hnp/bin/bash for HarmonyOS bash location.
issues.recommendation: This is a last-resort fallback in a chain (CONFIG_SHELL env → which bash → hardcoded path). Acceptable for HarmonyOS compatibility, but could break on other platforms. No action required.
